name: Кельд Дур-Ассен
notes: Keld Dur-Assen, a quiet secretary of the Kragmir city treasury and one of the three judges at Grog's trial. He says little and writes a great deal. Secretly he reports to Torvain Merok Dur-Karrag, and he cares nothing for the verdict: he came to watch the power that lives in Grog (Ansu) and to describe it. Table note: Weigh the Power is a secret check, so roll it blind.

actions.name: Weigh the Power
actions.text:
Кельд studies a creature he can see within 30 feet and attempts an @Check[occultism|defense:will] check against its Will DC. The target is then temporarily immune to Weigh the Power for 1 day.

Critical Success Кельд learns whether the creature carries a spirit, a curse, a possession or a divine bond, roughly how strong it is compared to his own level, and whether it is active right now.

Success Кельд learns whether the creature carries such a presence.

Critical Failure Кельд draws the opposite conclusion.

actions.name: Find the Seam
actions.text:
Frequency once per round

Effect Кельд watches how one creature within 30 feet shifts its weight and attempts a @Check[perception|defense:reflex] check against its Reflex DC. On a success, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Off-Guard] against the next Strike Кельд makes against it before the end of his turn.

actions.name: Unreadable
actions.text:
Trigger A creature attempts to [[/act sense-motive]]{Sense Motive} against Кельд, or Кельд is targeted by a mental effect that reads his thoughts or emotions

Effect Кельд gains a +2 circumstance bonus to his Deception DC and to his Will save against the triggering check or effect. If the triggering creature fails, it reads only a calm, true and useless thought: a column of figures.

actions.name: Unshakable Confidence
actions.text: All attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Coerce] Кельд have a result one degree worse.

actions.name: Unremarkable
actions.text: Кельд gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks to [[/act avoid-notice]]{Avoid Notice} and to Deception checks to [[/act impersonate]]{Impersonate} a minor official among the clerks, guards and crowds of Kragmir.
